movement_support.passages: Observed_passages records own gate/portal crossings; portal links retain direction and exit choice support. Offered whole routes may cross these learned pairs only while both ends are visible compatible entrances/exits; their arrival/loss estimates cover the entire offered known route. explore_passage may visit a visible gate/portal entrance with an unknown exit; an entry-only quote does not estimate that unknown exit or onward travel.
